name: @groupi/sdk
description: Explicit, instance-bound Groupi REST v2 client

scripts.test:run: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s ../python-sdk/tests && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.type-check: pnpm check:generated && tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json && python3 scripts/check-python-types.py
scripts.generate: tsx scripts/generate.ts && python3 scripts/generate-clients.py && prettier --write src/index.js src/index.d.ts && eslint src/index.d.ts --fix
